agent-eval.title: Lean Agent Evaluation
agent-eval.intro: Reduced evaluation tokens by 38% by compressing agent observations into micro rubrics and batch scoring.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: Evaluation gets expensive when every reply is rescored. Using three anchors—facts, tone, and next-step utility—keeps alignment while staying affordable.

sections.heading: Technique
sections.body: Binary checks for facts, a 1-3 tone scale, and freeform fix notes. Run the rubric straight from server actions.
